sr: Put od hiljadu milja počinje jednim korakom.
en: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.

sr: Učiti i ponavljati — nije li to radost?
en: To learn and review often — is that not a joy?

zh: 只要功夫深，铁杵磨成针。
sr: Upornošću se i gvozdeni tučak pretvori u iglu.
en: With enough persistence, even an iron rod can be ground into a needle.
Improve a little bit every day.

zh: 世上无难事，只怕有心人。
sr: Ništa nije teško onome ko ima volju.
en: Nothing is difficult for someone with determination.
Study well and make progress every day.

sr: Ne boj se sporosti, boj se stajanja.
en: Don't fear going slow, fear standing still.

sr: Učenje nema granica, duh nema kraja.
en: Learning has no limits, the spirit knows no bounds.

sr: Ako troje hodaju, bar jedan mi može biti učitelj.
en: Among three people walking, one can surely be my teacher.

sr: Gde ima volje, ima i načina.
en: Where there is a will, there is a way.

zh: 爱不是彼此凝视，而是一起朝同一个方向看。
sr: Ljubav nije gledanje jedno u drugo, već gledanje u istom pravcu.
en: Love is not gazing at each other, but looking outward together in the same direction.

zh: 海内存知己，天涯若比邻。
sr: Pravi prijatelj je blizu srcu, makar bio na drugom kraju sveta.
en: A true friend is close at heart, even if at the edge of the world.

sr: Za drvo treba deset godina, za čoveka sto.
en: It takes ten years to grow a tree, but a hundred years to nurture a person.

sr: Pročitaj deset hiljada knjiga, prepešači deset hiljada milja.
en: Read ten thousand books, travel ten thousand miles.

zh: 授人以鱼，不如授人以渔。
sr: Bolje je naučiti nekoga da peca, nego mu dati ribu.
en: Give a person a fish, and you feed them for a day; teach them to fish, and you feed them for a lifetime.
